# Copilot Instructions for CuantoCuestaUruguay

## Overview
This project, CuantoCuestaUruguay, is designed to provide users with information about costs in Uruguay. Understanding the architecture and workflows is essential for effective contributions.

## Architecture
- **Components**: The project is structured around several key components that interact to provide the desired functionality. Understanding these components and their interactions is crucial for any developer.
- **Data Flow**: Data flows between components through well-defined interfaces. Familiarize yourself with these interfaces to understand how data is processed and displayed.

## Developer Workflows
- **Building the Project**: Use the command `npm run build` to compile the project. Ensure all dependencies are installed beforehand.
- **Running Tests**: Execute `npm test` to run the test suite. This will help ensure that your changes do not break existing functionality.
- **Debugging**: Utilize the built-in debugging tools in your IDE. Set breakpoints and inspect variables to troubleshoot issues effectively.

## Project Conventions
- **Code Style**: Follow the established code style guidelines. Consistency in code formatting is key to maintaining readability and collaboration.
- **Commit Messages**: Use clear and descriptive commit messages. This helps in tracking changes and understanding the history of the project.

## Integration Points
- **External APIs**: The project integrates with several external APIs. Familiarize yourself with these integrations to understand how data is fetched and utilized.
- **Cross-Component Communication**: Components communicate through events and callbacks. Understanding these patterns will help you navigate the codebase more effectively.

## Key Files
- **`src/index.js`**: The entry point of the application. Review this file to understand the initial setup and configuration.
- **`src/components/`**: Contains the main components of the application. Each component is modular and can be understood independently.
- **`tests/`**: Contains unit and integration tests. Review these to understand the expected behavior of the application.

## Conclusion
By following these instructions, you will be better equipped to contribute to the CuantoCuestaUruguay project effectively. Familiarize yourself with the architecture, workflows, and conventions to maximize your productivity.
